verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses telemetry, usage tracking, or opt-out settings (e.g., Ubuntu's known 'Connectivity Check'/Popularity Contest/Ubuntu Report settings are not mentioned). While this is a fair axis for a desktop OS, the pack provides no documentation or discussion of telemetry controls. missing for 10: any mention of telemetry/data collection features, opt-out settings or privacy controls, independent confirmation of default telemetry behavior.
